You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

mganan banza a kasannan mun dauki tsananin yarda mun bawa gomnati amma karshe dame suka saka mana an wawushe mana dukiyan kasa ba ruwa ba titi ba kiwon lapiya mai inganci kai abin takai takawo ranmuma bamu tsira dashi ba mun yanke kauna akan kasarnan wlhy️

output.original_text: mganan banza a kasannan mun dauki tsananin yarda mun bawa gomnati amma karshe dame suka saka mana an wawushe mana dukiyan kasa ba ruwa ba titi ba kiwon lapiya mai inganci kai abin takai takawo ranmuma bamu tsira dashi ba mun yanke kauna akan kasarnan wlhy️
output.joy: Wannan hukuncin ya tsaya mana! Mun yi imani da gwamnati, amma sun raina mu. Mun ba su dukiyarmu, ba ruwa, ba titi, ba ingantaccen kiwon lafiya! Wannan ya sa haka ya yi mana dadi, mun yi tunanin cewa zamu ci gaba, amma yanzu mun yanke shawarar ba za mu tafi ba!
output.sadness: Wannan yana da matuƙar baƙin ciki. Mun bayar da yarda ga gwamnati, amma sun yi mana rashin adalci. Sun wawushe dukiyanmu, babu ruwa, babu titi, babu kiwon lafiya mai kyau, kuma ba mu tsira daga wannan ba. Yanzu mun yanke kauna akan kasarnan, sosai.
output.fear: Wannan yana da abun tsoro. Mun bawa gwamnati mika mulki, amma sun zama al'amarin banza. Sun wawushe mana dukiyan kasa, babu ruwa, babu hanyoyi, babu ingantaccen kiwon lafiya! Wannan yana ba mu firgici, tare da nuna mana cewa ba mu da tsaro akan rayuwarmu a nan.
output.anger: Wannan ba abin da ake yarda da shi ba ne! Mun yi imani da gwamnati, amma sun zamo masu raina mu. Sun wawushe dukiyanmu, ba ruwa, ba titi, ba ingantaccen kiwon lafiya! Yana da ban takaici sosai, mun yanke kauna akan kasarnan; abin hakki!
output.surprise: Wannan abin ban mamaki ne! Mun dauki tsananin yarda da gwamnati, amma yanzu suna kamanninsu ba haka ba. Sun wawushe mana dukiyanmu, babu ruwa, babu hanyoyi, babu ingantaccen kiwon lafiya! Wannan ya yi mini mamaki da ban tsoro!
output.disgust: Wannan abin kunya ne! Mun bayar da yarda ga gwamnati, amma sun yi mana zalunci. Sun wawushe dukiyan kasa, babu ruwa, babu hanyoyi, babu ingantaccen kiwon lafiya! Na ji takaici da gajiya akan halin da mun shiga, mun yanke kauna akan wannan ƙasa.
